rationale: Lowered loop aggressiveness for larger lag and fixed feedforward wind-up. Kp 0.65->0.50, Ki 0.022->0.010, Kd 12.0->3.0 with D-limit 0.10->0.06, I-limit 0.15->0.12, U_MAX 0.62->0.70. Kept fast filter tau 4s, added slow filter tau 20s for derivative and adaptation. Changed FF adaptation from |err|<0.05 with tau 120s tracking u unconditionally to |err|<0.025 AND |dy_slow|<0.0007 with tau 250s, so FF only learns steady-state duty when inside band and settled. This stops FF being dragged from 0.45 toward 0.60 during approach (cause of v1 prolonged 0.53-0.54 hold and v2 0.43-0.59 limit cycle) while still allowing u* to re-estimate if plant gain/ambient shifts. Kept anti-windup freeze on saturation and 0.68/0.80 safety caps.
